options.text: Deploy shared AVD services: Secrets and Encryption Key Vaults, Log Analytics and AVD Insights resources, and an FSLogix Recovery Services vault with an Azure Files snapshot backup policy. Run this deployment before host pools, image management, or add-ons that consume these shared resources.

elements.name: deployFSLogixBackupVault
elements.label: Deploy FSLogix Backup Vault and Policy

options.text: Optionally deploy one regional Recovery Services vault and Azure Files snapshot backup policy for FSLogix profile storage. The vault is shared by pooled host pools and standalone FSLogix storage deployments. Profile snapshots remain in each storage account; the vault stores backup policy and scheduling metadata.

options.text: The Secrets Key Vault (Standard SKU) stores AVD credentials: VM local administrator and domain join account. Downstream deployers reference this vault by resource ID only — they do not need read access to the secrets themselves. To read secrets at deployment time (e.g., for getSecret() ARM references), the deploying identity needs the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role.

elements.name: enableSoftDelete
elements.label: Enable Soft Delete
elements.toolTip: Allow recovery of deleted Key Vault objects within the retention period.

elements.name: enablePurgeProtection
elements.label: Enable Purge Protection
elements.toolTip: Prevent permanent deletion of the Key Vault and its objects during the retention period. Strongly recommended for production environments.

elements.name: retentionDays
elements.label: Soft Delete Retention (Days)
elements.toolTip: Number of days to retain soft-deleted Key Vault objects before permanent deletion.

options.text: Provide the AVD session host credentials to store in the Secrets Key Vault. All fields are optional — you can store credentials later by re-running this deployment. Domain join credentials are only required for ADDS or Entra Kerberos hybrid environments.

elements.name: virtualMachineAdminUserName

options.text: Define your naming convention using the components below. The defaults follow the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) naming convention: {resource-type}-avd-{identifier}-{region}. Adjust the component order, separator, workload value, or abbreviations to match your organization's standard.

Select the components that make up your naming convention and arrange them in order using Component 1 through Component 6. Select 'None (stop here)' to end the sequence. Auto-resolved components — Resource Type, Purpose, Location — are substituted per resource at deployment time. Value components — Workload, Environment, Free-form Text 1, Free-form Text 2 — require you to supply a value in the fields that appear below.

Recommended components for conflict-free, identifiable names: Required - Resource Type (identifies the resource category: rg, kv, pe, nic), Purpose (distinguishes the secrets and encryption Key Vaults), Workload (scopes names to your application or project). Highly Recommended - Location (prevents name collisions when deploying across regions).

elements.name: delimiter

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a single character: hyphen (-) or underscore (_).
